name: Wicked Heart
overview: Scripture reveals the wickedness of the human heart as deeply rooted and pervasive, with Genesis 6:5 describing it as continually evil in thought and imagination. Jeremiah 17:9 emphasizes the heart’s deceitfulness and desperate wickedness, raising the question of who can truly know it. Yet, God offers hope through transformation, promising in Ezekiel 36:26 to replace the stony, wicked heart with a new heart and spirit. Believers are called to guard their hearts diligently, recognizing that life’s outcomes flow from it, as Proverbs 4:23 instructs.
